author: claude
description: Longhouse(length=21, wall, post, roof, ridge, base, floor) is an 11 x 11 x length Norse hall with bowed long walls (so the roof ridge curves), dark oak walls with log posts every 4 blocks, spruce stair roof, crossed dragon boards on both gables, doors at the south gable and both long sides amidships. Inside: long hearth of campfires, wall benches, high seat flanked by gold and lanterns, chests, barrels, tables, hanging lanterns. Floor local y=0. RuneStone() is a 3x6x2 Jelling-style carved stone. build(length) is a 21 x 11 x (length+7) yard with path, runestone, spruces and a woodpile; ground_level 1, door south.
name: viking_longhouse
title: Viking longhouse and runestone
